notes.title: Aseprite v1.3.10 & v1.3.11-beta
notes.content:
Hi asepriters! This week we’ve released Aseprite v1.3.10.1 and v1.3.11-beta2 with new major features.

New beta versions are going to be available only [url=https://www.aseprite.org/beta/]through Steam[/url] as it is easier to release quick fixes for important crashes/regressions. notes.title: Aseprite v1.3.3 released!
notes.content:
Hi Asepriters! Today we are releasing Aseprite v1.3.3 with several bug fixes and some improvements. You can check the [url=https://www.aseprite.org/release-notes/]release notes[/url] for more details.

[h2]What's new[/h2]

New range for opacity and alpha values in percentage. Now you will see opacity values from 0% to 100%, and alpha values from 0 to 255 by default:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/7c98906ae4848fd61700a8bd64dbe3e2ce31dc77.png[/img]

You can configure this from [i]Edit > Preferences > Color > Alpha & Opacity[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/abcccc787ee1bd666840599b162abf2054c153d6.png[/img]

Added support to follow subtags/repetitions instructions when exporting animations:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/915bcad40fea2edf05a9cb6e3d8527489f54b5f5.png[/img]

New button to reload palette presets:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/380aaf0335572d09e8d6c640f1aa3eb8fb1bdd9f.png[/img]

[h2]Translations[/h2]

New official translations included thanks to the help of several [url=https://github.com/aseprite/strings/blob/main/README.md]contributors[/url]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/32a81eacdc36ba333cf72474378a8300d396aa4b.png[/img]

This is (and will be) a work-in-progress in [url=https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/aseprite/]Weblate[/url]. Any kind of help will be greatly appreciated!

notes.title: Aseprite v1.3
notes.content:
Welcome Asepriters! Today we are finally releasing Aseprite v1.3 as
the stable version replacing the previous v1.2.40. It is already live
on Steam and [url=https://www.aseprite.org/faq/#how-do-i-update-my-current-version]all our
platforms[/url].

If you were already using v1.3 beta or a release candidate, you can
check out the [url=https://www.aseprite.org/release-notes/]release notes[/url]
just to check the latest fixes/features. If you came from v1.2, we
recommend you to check out the new features in this post.

[h2]What’s new[/h2]
The main new feature on Aseprite v1.3 are [url=https://www.aseprite.org/docs/tilemap/]tilemap layers[/url]:

[previewyoutube=ukdxF8XgewI;full][/previewyoutube]

A summary of other minor features you can find in v1.3 from v1.2:
[list]
  [*][url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1397596222584672260]Dark theme[/url][/*]
  [*][url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1397596243438751747]Skew transformation[/url][/*]
  [*][url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1397596256390766594]Text fields for the transformation[/url][/*]
  [*][url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1397596268550049801]Resize tags dragging borders[/url][/*]

  [*][url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1397596285587410956]Pick colors from the desktop[/url][/*]
  [*][url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1659270170186063883]Z-index to re-order layers in specific frames[/url][/*]
  [*][url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1403309287737266176]New mouse/pen stabilizer[/url][/*]
  [*][url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1397596298031910914]Global user data to sprites[/url][/*]
  [*]Ctrl+Shift+Drag mouse Change brush size + drag values customization from [u]Edit > Keyboard Shortcuts > Drag Value[/u][/*]
  [*]Shift+F7: [url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1681807936010502145]Hide other layers on Preview window[/url][/*]
  [*]Space+X/Space+H (flip horizontally), Space+Y/Space+V (flip vertically), Space+D (flip diagonally), Space+R (rotate): Flip/rotate custom brushes or tiles[/*]
  [*]New scripting capabilities like the [url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/1630944164383735808]canvas widget[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/martincapell0/status/1697702679512834520]tabs[/url][/*]

notes.title: Aseprite update for Steam on macOS Ventura
notes.content:
Due a new issue with macOS Ventura, we've made some changes to Aseprite packages on Steam.

If you see the following popup when you try to run Aseprite on macOS, it's highly probably that you've updated your system to macOS 13.0 Ventura. Just press "Move to Trash" button:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/e5e85dcfbf96de4e57e0d9d6c48fd19416a877f0.png[/img]

Then re-start Steam, and press the Launch button on Aseprite, you might see an error like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/333e9912d8fd5e1a1fdafc17121e57d6cff77d11.png[/img]

But in a second try launching Aseprite, Steam will re-install Aseprite:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/b1376110b4120345294133a7dd91d031c07ee208.png[/img]

That should be enough.

[hr][/hr]

In any case, if you have Aseprite installed and the problem still persists, you can right-click Aseprite and select [i]Manage > Browse local files[/i] and delete the Aseprite folder:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/f1b7f7e3625541fabcb8cf8d75b111af33b218be.png[/img]

Then re-start Steam, and re-install Aseprite. Restarting Steam is important because that leads to re-downloading some metadata about the new version that is available on Steam.

[hr][/hr]

For more details: https://community.aseprite.org/t/aseprite-update-for-steam-on-macos-ventura/16229

notes.title: Aseprite v1.2
notes.content:
Aseprite v1.2 is finally the new stable version.  If you were already using the beta version, you will not notice substancial changes. But if you were using Aseprite v1.1.13, there are a [url=https://www.aseprite.org/release-notes/#aseprite-v1-2]lot of new features[/url] for you (like [url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/734869697896845312/photo/1]pixel aspect ratio[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/aseprite/status/768071505288785920]layer groups[/url], [url=https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/issues/920#issuecomment-289330287]overlapping frame tags[/url], [url=https://youtu.be/9Q6uET0blK0]gradients[/url], [url=https://imgur.com/A1w7QLq]reference layers[/url], etc.).

This is a list of the changes from v1.2-beta12 to the final v1.2:
[list]
  [*]Added new Addition, Subtract, Divide blending modes[/*]
  [*]Added support to change theme and UI scaling without restarting[/*]
  [*]Disable transformation handles in the selection when a Shift or Shift+Alt are pressed by default[/*]
  [*]Fixed high CPU usage on Timeline when we copy layers/frames/cels[/*]
  [*]Fixed snap to grid bug with selection tool[/*]
  [*]Fixed crash closing all files & opening a new one when preview window was playing an animation[/*]
  [*]Windows: New [b]x64 version[/b] (included in the installer and on Steam, it’ll install the x64 version on x64 machines)[/*]
  [*]Windows: New --disable-wintab option to avoid loading wintab32.dll[/*]
  [*][b]Removed Windows XP support[/b] (Please contact us in case that you still need a previous version with Windows XP support.)[/*]
  [*]macOS: Use the native macOS menu bar[/*]
  [*]macOS: Now ⌘M and ⌘H will Minimize and Hide the window respectively. Use Ctrl+M for Color Curves, and Ctrl+H to change [u]View > Show Extras[/u] options.[/*]
  [*]macOS: Fixed bug setting broken mouse cursors in some special cases[/*]
  [*]macOS: Retina support[/*]
  [*]Several other bugs[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://blog.aseprite.org/2017/09/25/aseprite-v12/]More information in the blog[/url]

[*]Tab key cycle through RGB/HSV color text fields
[*]Show all tools/quicktools on keyboard shortcuts preferences
[*]Fixed crashing when the user-defined theme doesn't exist anymore
[*]Fixed bug which we can get stuck moving a cel
[*]Fixed crash using "Play Once" option
[*]Fixed several bugs & issues

[*]Added new --oneframe CLI parameter to load just one frame
[*]Fixed loading layer groups from .ase files with complex hierarchies/multiple levels
[*]Fixed all commands related to the entire canvas (resize sprite, rotate sprite, flip sprite, etc.) when the sprite contains collapsed groups
[*]+All changes in v1.1.10
